entries.title: The Fifth to Die

entries.description:

 For Detective Sam Porter, the words “Father, forgive me” conjure memories long forgotten; a past intentionally buried. For Anson Bishop, these three words connect a childhood to the present as he unleashes a truth concealed for decades.

entries.title: The First Scarlet Door
entries.author: J.D. Barker
entries.description:
In the first of three prequels to New York Times bestselling author J.D. Barker's wildly popular 4MK series...

Before he was known as the Four Monkey Killer, he was just a boy trying to survive.

Charleston, 1999. Fifteen-year-old Anson Bishop didn't mean to kill—not the first time, anyway. Raised by parents who taught him that murder was simply survival, Anson thought he'd escaped his dark past…
